info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Careers Applications Jobs-v2-spec
info.description: The Career Opportunities Listing API facilitates access to a curated list of job applications available within the organization. This endpoint provides a comprehensive overview of positions that candidates can apply for, including details like job titles, locations, and descriptions. It is primarily designed for job seekers looking to explore available opportunities as well as recruiters aiming to manage and promote job offerings. Utilize this API to enhance your recruitment process or to integrate job listing functionalities into your applications.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of job applications
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve a comprehensive list of job applications submitted by users. You can filter and paginate the results to find specific applications.

requestBody.description: This request is used to retrieve job application data. The request body should include necessary filters and parameters to specify which jobs are being queried. Ensure to format the JSON structure correctly to avoid errors.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning a list of job applications.

ListCareersApplicationsJobsRequest.title: Request Body for Applications Jobs Operations GET
ListCareersApplicationsJobsRequest.description: This schema represents the body of the request for the GET operation on applications jobs. The request body is expected to be a string.

ListCareersApplicationsJobsResponse_200.title: Job Application Response

status.description: Indicates whether the job application status retrieval was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the job application.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the job application.

state.description: The current state of the job application.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the application, expressed in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the job application status.

ListCareersApplicationsJobsResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response for a job application retrieval operation.
